chat.author: Pablo Madoery
chat.text: Is the heuristic (used to get contacts out of the visibility) available?

chat.author: Dan York
chat.text: It's great to see this constellation registry! Congrats to those who made it happen.

chat.author: Joerg Ott
chat.text: Dan, the credits go to you for doing all this collection in the first place and triggering it!

chat.author: Gorry Fairhurst
chat.text: Do we know which group(s) in 3GPP might actually benefit from knowing more about DTN?

chat.author: Gorry Fairhurst
chat.text: @Joerg ... If we knew, we could raise it at the 3GPP-IETF liaison.

chat.author: Gorry Fairhurst
chat.text: @Joerg (silly)  - I was so impressed by your clothing blending with the palette of the Podiem and background image.

chat.author: Dan York
chat.text: Too funny... @Joerg really DID choose the appropriate shirt for today! :rolling_on_the_floor_laughing:

chat.author: Gorry Fairhurst
chat.text: We plan to join LEOScope early 2027, with one of our Starlink terminals in Aberdeen :-)

chat.author: Dan York
chat.text: I will see anyone who will be in San Francisco.

chat.author: Gorry Fairhurst
chat.text: Yes Thanks!!! - get in touch with me if you're in SF!
